architectural_notes: App appears to be deployed on Internet Computer (IC) with frontend + backend canisters accessed via a gateway/domain routing.
known_issues: Deployment/runtime issue: gateway reports 'Canister ID Not Resolved' and frontend shows 'Failed to load stories' after 1–2 seconds, suggesting frontend loads but backend canister is unavailable/not resolving.

existing_features.title: Add an explicit backend availability check and expose it to the frontend so the app can distinguish between (a) backend canister unreachable / not yet propagated and (b) application-level errors.

Improve the 'Failed to load stories' error state on the stories feed to show actionable troubleshooting and canister details (frontend asset canister ID, backend API canister ID when available, standard URL, raw URL), and provide one-click actions.

Update retry/backoff behavior for fetching published stories to reduce perceived slowness and provide clear progress feedback during the first ~10–15 seconds after page load when the backend is not yet reachable.

projectName: Improve user-visible deployment diagnostics and backend availability checks for 'Failed to load stories'
